notes: The page links two different youth application PDFs, so ask which one is current. Schedule and hours are not posted. Contact: 410-545-5940.
name: Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at the science center and help visitors. The page does not list the exact jobs.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 15 to 17 who work well with kids and teens and are comfortable talking with the public.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Youth Volunteer Application and send it to the Volunteer Coordinator (volunteers@mdsci.org). Expect a placement interview.
